prompt: Charming, clear educational infographic in clean botanical illustration style, showing the mushroom life cycle as a circular sequence of five stages arranged clockwise around a light background. Stage 1: spores landing and germinating on soil, with small sprouting spore cells. Stage 2: threadlike white mycelium spreading through brown soil, shown as fine branching filaments. Stage 3: a tiny pin-stage mushroom emerging from the mycelium. Stage 4: a young mushroom growing into a mature cap, with an accurate anatomy: rounded cap, stem (stipe), ring, and visible gills underneath the cap. Stage 5: the mature gills releasing a cloud of spores that drift back to the start of the cycle. Each stage has a simple readable label. Earthy color palette of warm browns, moss greens, cream, and terracotta accents. Light off-white background, balanced composition, soft even lighting, crisp line work, no clutter.
negativePrompt: photo, photorealistic, dark background, cluttered, distorted anatomy, extra mushrooms beyond the cycle, unreadable text, watermark, blurry, low detail
